stories.title: 哪座纸桥更牢固
paragraphs: In science class, we built two paper bridges. Both bridges had the same width and crossed the same gap between two books. One bridge was flat. My partner folded the other bridge back and forth before we set it in place.

We put a small weight in the middle of the flat bridge. It bent right away. Then we put a heavier weight on the folded bridge. It held. We had built a stronger bridge with one sheet of paper. We measured the span between the books and wrote down our results so another group could try.
translation: 科学课上，我们搭了两座纸桥。两座桥一样宽，都跨在两本书之间。第一座桥是平的。同桌把另一座桥来回折叠后，我们把它放到了原位。
我们在平纸桥中间放了个小砝码。它立刻弯了。接着，我们把更重的砝码放在折叠的桥上。它撑住了。我们用一张纸搭了一座更牢固的桥。我们量了两本书之间的跨度，记下结果，让另一组也能试一试。

stories.title: 我和影子谁更长
paragraphs: In the morning, our class went outside to measure shadows. I stood by a line on the ground. My partner marked the end of my shadow with a piece of chalk. We used a metre stick to measure its length.

At noon, I stood on the same line. My shadow was shorter. Our teacher asked us to try again later in the day. When the sun hung lower in the sky, my shadow grew longer again. I drew three pictures of the same spot and labelled them morning, noon and afternoon.
translation: 早上，我们班到室外量影子。我站在地上的一条线旁，同桌用粉笔标出影子的末端。我们用一米长的尺子量影子的长度。
中午，我又站在同一条线上。这次影子短了。老师请我们晚一点再量一次。太阳在天上的位置更低时，我的影子又变长了。我画了同一个地方的三幅图，分别标上早晨、中午和下午。

stories.title: 给盒子留一点位置
paragraphs: On Friday, our teacher asked us to pack books for the reading corner. I chose a small box for the thin books and a bigger one for the thick books. Ben tried to put the last book in the bigger box. The book was too wide.

We took a measurement of the book and wrote it down. I found a box one centimetre wider than the book. It was also shorter than our first box. We put the wide book flat inside it and filled the space above it with smaller books. We carried both boxes to the library.
translation: 周五，老师让我们给阅读角打包图书。我选一个小盒子放薄书，一个大一点的盒子放厚书。本试着把最后一本书放进大盒子，可那本书太宽了。
我们量了书，把测量结果记了下来。我找到了一个比书宽一厘米的盒子，它也比原先的大盒子矮。我们把宽书平放进去，再在上面放几本小一点的书。我们把两个盒子搬去了图书馆。

stories.title: 阳光照进来以前
paragraphs: Last Saturday, the rain hit the windows all morning. I stayed indoors and read a magazine by the window. The room grew dark, so I switched on the lamp. A few minutes later, the lights went out.

My sister opened the curtain to let in more light. Then we sat closer to the window and took turns reading a story. After lunch, the power came back and the rain stopped. We finished the story before we went outside. On Sunday, I drew a picture of the two of us reading by the window.

stories.title: 阁楼里的照片
paragraphs: Yesterday, Mum and I cleaned the attic. We found a dusty box under a chair. Mum opened it and took out a photo of a girl with a bicycle. I looked closely and saw that the girl was my mum.

The photo showed her first bike. She told me she had learned to ride it in a park near our home. We sorted the rest of the belongings in the box. Mum kept the old photo on her desk. I wrote the date on the back after she told me the year.

stories.title: 周末的小修理
paragraphs: Last Sunday, I helped Dad in the living room. The handle on our window was broken, so Dad fetched a new one from the toolbox. He asked me to stay on the floor while he used a ladder to reach the window.

I put the little parts on a tray in the order Dad needed them. He fixed the handle and asked me to try it from the floor once he had moved the ladder away. The window opened easily. After we finished, we put away the tools and wrote a note about which parts we had used.

stories.title: 一夜雷雨
paragraphs: My family went camping near a lake. In the afternoon, we walked around the campsite and set up our tent. A worker showed us a building where campers could go in bad weather. That evening, a thunderstorm came.

Dad turned on a flashlight, and we walked with him to the building. We played a game there while we waited for the storm to pass. The next morning, the path was muddy, so we wore our boots to pack the tent. We came home with wet bags and a story to tell.
translation: 我家去湖边露营。下午，我们在营地四处走了走，然后搭好帐篷。工作人员指给我们看一栋楼，天气不好时露营者可以去那里。傍晚下起了雷雨。
爸爸打开手电筒，我们跟着他走进那栋楼。等雷雨过去时，我们在那里玩了个游戏。第二天早上路上全是泥，我们穿着靴子收帐篷。我们带着湿漉漉的包回家，也带回了一个能讲给别人听的故事。

stories.title: 桥边的钓鱼竿
stories.titleEn: The Fishing Rod by the Bridge
paragraphs: Grandpa and I went fishing by a creek on Sunday. He showed me how to hold a fishing rod. We waited beside a wooden bridge. A small bird came close to the water, and I took pictures of it from the bank.

When we packed up, we found a basket beside the bridge. It had an apple and a bottle of water inside. We took it to the park desk. A girl came to look for her lunch, and the worker gave the basket back to her. She thanked us and offered to share the apple.
translation: 周日，我和爷爷去小溪边钓鱼。他教我怎么拿钓鱼竿。我们在木桥旁等着。一只小鸟来到水边，我从岸上给它拍了照片。
收拾东西时，我们在桥边发现一个篮子。里面有一个苹果和一瓶水。我们把篮子送到公园服务台。一个女孩来找自己的午饭，工作人员把篮子还给了她。她谢了我们，还提出和我们分享苹果。

stories.title: 海湾上的第一程
stories.titleEn: The First Trip Across the Bay
paragraphs: Last summer, my cousin and I visited a small bay with our aunt. We wanted to try a kayak. A guide gave each of us a life jacket and showed us how to sit. We practised moving our paddles while the boat was still by the beach.

At first, we turned in a circle. Our guide told us to paddle on opposite sides. We tried again and went straight towards a red marker. On the way back, we saw a crab on a rock. I drew it in my notebook after we got out of the boat.
translation: 去年夏天，我和表弟跟姨妈去了一个小海湾。我们想试试皮划艇。向导给我们每人一件救生衣，告诉我们该怎么坐。小船还在沙滩边时，我们练习划桨。
刚开始我们转了个圈。向导让我们分别在两边划桨。我们再试一次，船就直直朝红色标记划去。回程时，我们看到岩石上有只螃蟹。下船后，我把它画在了本子里。

stories.title: 操场过去的样子
paragraphs: Our class made a timeline of changes at school. A former pupil brought a photo from twenty years ago. The playground looked different in her photo. The gym was a small room, and there was grass where our running track is now.

We took a new photo from the same place. Two students drew arrows between the photos to show the changes. The former pupil helped us add the year to each picture. At the school show, younger children used the timeline to find the oldest photo and ask questions about it.
translation: 我们班做了一条记录学校变化的时间线。一位校友带来一张二十年前的照片。她照片里的操场和现在不一样。那时体育馆只是个小房间，现在是跑道的地方以前是一片草地。
我们站在同一个位置拍了一张新照片。两个同学在照片之间画了箭头，标出变化。校友帮我们在每张照片上写了年份。学校展示时，低年级的孩子顺着时间线找到了最早的照片，还问了几个问题。

stories.title: 记分牌翻过来
paragraphs: I played a badminton match with my teammate Mei on Friday. At first I held my racket too tightly, and the shuttlecock went into the net. Mei told me to take a breath before I tried again.

After a few turns, our score began to rise. I could see the new number on the scoreboard. We lost the match by one point, but I was pleased that I had learned to move my feet more quickly. After the game, we shook hands with the other team and wrote down one thing to practise next week.
translation: 周五，我和队友梅打了一场羽毛球比赛。一开始我把球拍握得太紧，羽毛球打在了网上。梅让我先吸口气再试。
打了几轮后，我们开始得分。我能看见记分牌上的新数字。我们差一分输了比赛，可我很高兴自己学会了更快地移动脚步。赛后我们和对方队伍握手，记下下周要练的一件事。

stories.title: 纪念册最后一页
stories.titleEn: The Last Page of the Yearbook
paragraphs: On the day before graduation, our teacher gave us time to sign each other's yearbook. I thought about what to write on the last page. My friend Rui and I had shared many ordinary school days. I chose one memory from our first week.

Rui had helped me find the dining hall when I was new. We had walked there together every day that week. I wrote about that small act on the page and thanked him for it. At our farewell party, Rui showed me his note. He had written about the same week.
translation: 毕业前一天，老师留出时间让我们互相在纪念册上签名。我想了想最后一页要写什么。朋友睿和我一起度过了许多普通的上学日。我选了刚入学第一周的一件回忆。
我刚来时，睿帮我找到了食堂。那一周，我们每天都一起走去那里。我在纪念册上写下这件小事，向他道谢。告别聚会上，睿给我看他写的留言。原来他也写了同一周的事。
